iti73:2.1: arūpā → āruppā (cck: sī.) | arūpā → aruppā, P. Pa. (pts note) | santatarā → santarā, C. P. Pa. (pts note) | santataro → santaro, C. Pa. (pts note) | ti → cāti, B. (pts note)
iti73:3.2: āruppaṭhāyino → arūpaṭhāyino (bj: machasaṁ) | arūpaṭṭhāyino → āruppaṭṭhāyino (cck: sī.) | arūpaṭṭhāyino → arūpavāsino, P. Pa., and C. in the interpolation mentioned before; -gāmino, B., and C. in the proper place. The first two pādas occur Saṁyuttanik. V. 4, 5. (pts note)
iti73:3.3: appajānantā → -anti, C. (both times), and Pa. in the interpolation. (pts note)
iti73:3.4: āgantāro → āgantāno, B., agandhāro, C. (pts note)
iti73:4.1: rūpe → Ye ca rūpe all MSS., but see sutt. 51 for the second and third gāthā. (pts note)
iti73:4.2: asaṇṭhitā → susaṇṭhitā (pts) | arūpesu → āruppesu, D. E.; ye ca rūpesu, Pa. (pts note)
iti73:5.1: amatadhātuṁ → amataṁ dhātuṁ (bj, cck) | amatadhātuṁ phusayitvā nirūpadhiṁ → amataṁ dhātuṁ phussayitvā nirūpadhi (sya-all) | amatadhātuṁ phusayitvā → amataṁ dhātuṁ phassayitvā (pts)
iti73:5.2: phassayitvā → phassayitvā, P. Pa.; phuss-, C.; phusay-, B. M.; phūsay-, D. E. (pts note) | nirūpadhiṁ → nirūpadhiṁ, M.; -dhi, the other MSS. The long ū may be due to a wrong connexion of this word with rūpa. (pts note)
iti73:5.3: upadhippaṭinissaggaṁ → -ppaṭi-; M., the other MSS. have -paṭi-. (pts note)
